card.name: The word dialogue itself
card.fires_on: The word dialogue (or dialog, as in dialogues) as a noun, including its first piece before -ues. It appears in interfaith talks, Plato's dialogues, medical dialogue and classroom speech.

modes.label: Interfaith and cultural dialogue
modes.description: Dialogue as talk between religions or groups.
modes.example: The history of interfaith<< dialogue>> is as ancient as the religions since men

modes.label: Written or spoken dialogues
modes.description: Dialogue as a literary work or recorded speech, including the split form dialog-ues.
modes.example: Among the<< dialog>>ues with Job, where the Lord is

card.writes: It pushes the model toward dialog and dialogs spellings and forms.
card.plain: It lights up on the word dialogue, whether it means a conversation between groups or a written work.
